decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Email from Agent (Dated 21/04/2026),SuDS Proforma,Fire Safety Strategy,SAP Calculations (x3),A.F/PL01C (Dated 21/04/2026),A.F/PL02A (Dated 01/12/2025),Location Plan,Planning Statement/Design and Access Statement,Sheffield Stands Details,Energy Statement,Part L 2021 Performance Spreadsheet,Cycle Parking Design Compliance Report,Highway Safety Impact Form.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Within one month of the date of this permission, 4 long stay cycle parking spaces to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers on site shall have been fully provided. The occupation of the development shall cease if approved cycling parking has not provided on site within one month of the date of this permission. If this is the case, the applicant will be responsible to submit an application to vary this condition as appropriate. The dedicated cycle storage area within the rear garage shall fulfil the following:-	Provide step free access.-	Have aisles at least 1.5 metres wide to allow for easy manoeuvring.-	Provide a minimum width of at least 1 metre between stands.-	Provide an access door with a minimum width of at least 1.2 metres.-	Be secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob to provide greater security.Cycle parking shall be retained on site thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.In the event of a legal challenge to this decision, or to a decision made pursuant to the procedure set out in this condition, the operation of the time limits specified in this condition shall be suspended until that legal challenge has been finally determined.Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

The HMO hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than 4 residents at any one time, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not compromise standards of accommodation and does not adversely affect the residential amenities of neighbouring properties.

Within one month of the date of this permission, waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers shall have been provided on site, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). The occupation of the development shall cease if appropriate waste and recycling facilities have not been provided on site within one month of the date of this permission. If this is the case, the applicant will be responsible to submit an application to vary this condition as appropriate.Waste storage and recycling facilities are to be retained thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.In the event of a legal challenge to this decision, or to a decision made pursuant to the procedure set out in this condition, the operation of the time limits specified in this condition shall be suspended until that legal challenge has been finally determined.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms, and the ground floor communal kitchen, living and dining room, shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (house in multiple occupation - HMO) (PART-RETROSPECTIVE).
